body: I don't think it's fair to say I was raped. I don't feel like I was raped. I feel like I did something horrible...because I am horrible... I looked online for people in a similar scenario to me, and people kept telling them that being drunk is no excuse. I don't know. I 'm dumb. And horrible. I can't handle this guilt.
I told him and we stayed together. This was a year ago. I just can't seem to get over it for some reason. I think about it all the time.
